steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In January 2023, Equity Mates described Core Lithium as a lithium miner with mines in the Northern Territory and South Australia, outlining the basic product and where it operated.

episode.title: Australia's hottest lithium project - Core Lithium | Summer Series

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?
Can it reinvest its profits productively?
Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In August 2024, Equity Mates noted Core Lithium was removed from the ASX 200 after a 12 month share price fall of 86%, using it to illustrate how index rebalances drop companies falling out of favour.

episode.title: Why Index Investing: You don't miss out on growth | iShares by BlackRock
